source.name: USDA FSIS FoodKeeper data (English JSON)
source.retrieved_via: https://web.archive.org/web/20260416174248id_/https://www.foodsafety.gov/sites/default/files/foodkeeper_data_url_en.json (direct fsis.usda.gov/foodsafety.gov downloads returned HTTP 403 from our network)
source.method: For each category, cited FoodKeeper products; each range reduced to its shorter end; category value = minimum across cited products. Weeks x7, months x30, years x365. Non-numeric values ('When Ripe', 'Package use-by date', 'Not Recommended', 'Indefinitely') are never converted; they yield null.

examples_note: Item->category mapping is our editorial judgment (not from FoodKeeper). Items like peanut butter (FoodKeeper #387 opened 2-3 Months) are approximated by their category.
app_category_key_note: app_category_key maps to CATEGORIES in server/src/domain/schemas.ts (main @ 4db1960). Lossy: raw ground meat + raw whole cuts -> raw_meat (1 vs 3 fridge days), soft + hard cheese -> dairy_cheese (7 vs 180), butter has no app key (-> other). receipt_lines extra categories non_food/discount/deposit/fee have no app key (use 'other' or drop before pantry insert).
